description: The core-app registry: the ONE place a platform-provided core app is declared. A core app is an ordinary App Definition that the platform provisions into every tenant, addressed by its permanent `systemKey` (never by its handle, which stays a disposable URL-facing address). Adding a core app must cost exactly one entry here plus its definition file — if it ever costs more, the core-app architecture has failed.

conventions.definitions: Each version listed in `versions` must exist as schema/core/<systemKey>.<version>.json. EVERY shipped version stays checked in: the compatibility validator replays each previous version against the current one, and a validator that can only see the current definition cannot tell an append from a breaking change.
conventions.current: The LAST entry of `versions` is the one provisioned. Versions are append-only; never edit a shipped file in place.
conventions.defaultAccess: AllMembersRead = every tenant member reaches the app with no grant row, holding `defaultRole`. AdminOnly = platform admins only; members need an explicit grant.
conventions.defaultRole: The app-definition role key implicitly held by every tenant member under AllMembersRead. It must exist in the definition's `roles`.
